_note: Seed areas for /audit. The scout may move files between areas; update this file when the repo's layout changes. Every git-tracked non-image file should appear exactly once.

areas.name: Oyster Passport / customer accounts
focus: Phone sign-in flow: what happens on failed, expired or repeated codes
Can one customer read or write another customer's /users or /toastOrders data
Personal data (name, phone, email, date of birth): where it is shown, stored, logged, and whether the privacy page matches what the code does
Delete-my-account: does it remove everything the privacy page says it does
innerHTML / template strings built from customer-entered text
Birthday reward and stamp logic: can it be claimed twice or edited by the customer

areas.name: Employee page and manager tools
focus: Who can reach each staff action, and is that enforced on the server (rules or cloud functions) or only hidden in the page
Merroir sign-in: session handling, sign-out, what a non-staff signed-in user can see
Catalog editing: input validation, what a bad save does to data/oysters.js
Menu overrides and happy hour: what the page sends vs what cloud functions accept
employee.html size (1,800+ lines): duplicated logic, dead code, how hard it is to change safely

areas.name: Database rules and cloud functions
focus: Every rule: is it as narrow as it can be; is any path open to unauthenticated writes
Staff check (root.child('staff')): who can add themselves to /staff
Each callable function: auth check, input validation, what a malicious caller could send
GH_DISPATCH_TOKEN: scope, where it is used, whether any response leaks it
Do rules-test.js and cloud/test.js cover the paths and functions that matter; what is untested
firebase.json: legacy hosting/functions config that a bare `firebase deploy` would publish

areas.name: Toast to Firebase sync
focus: Which sync path is live (see known-context.md) and which files are dead
Failure behaviour: Toast down, token expired, partial or malformed response — does the menu go blank or keep the last good list
Toast item to catalog matching: GUID overrides, name collisions, oysters with the same name from different farms
Workflow: secret handling (the credentials file written to /tmp), permissions, the business-hours check across daylight saving
Number of Toast API calls per run

areas.name: Customer-facing menu pages
focus: What a customer sees when the database is slow, unreachable, or /menu/serving is empty
Prices and happy hour: does the page always agree with cloud/price-logic.js
innerHTML built from catalog or database text
Load weight on a phone: script count, image sizes, number of database listeners
Third-party scripts and where they load from
Accessibility basics on the main menu: text contrast, tap targets, alt text

areas.name: Library page and build tooling
focus: build-library.yml has contents: write and pushes to main: what input could make it commit something wrong
Generator escaping: catalog text going into the generated page
photo-check.js: still needed or dead

areas.name: Toast probes and repo housekeeping
focus: Hardcoded credentials, tokens, GUIDs that should be secrets, or real customer data
Scripts that write to anything (files, Toast, Firebase) when someone expects a read-only probe
.gitignore: anything secret or generated that is not ignored
README and migration-checklist: accurate for how the site works today

areas.name: Contracts between areas
focus: Every database path: who writes it, who reads it, what rule guards it (start from map.json db_paths)
Catalog schema: data/oysters.js as written by Merroir vs as read by the sync, the pages, the library builder and the tests
Price logic: cloud/price-logic.js vs src/price-display.js — same answers for the same inputs?
src/firebase-config.js and shared helpers: every page that loads them, and any page that does its own setup instead
86 status: does every reader treat it as 'not currently offered'

areas.name: Repo-wide conventions for future developers
focus: Naming, file layout, and module style: where the repo is inconsistent
Two ways of doing the same thing (e.g. Firebase setup, escaping, date handling)
Comments and docs that no longer match the code
How to run each test and tool: is it written down anywhere a new developer would look
Draft a short style guide from what the code already does most often
